verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a templates API, HTML/MJML template authoring, variable substitution, or any version-control workflow for templates. The only template-related mentions are a basic template library and a drag-and-drop editor, both UI features. Generic headless API access and a campaign-creation endpoint are adjacent capabilities, not template-as-code management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control
